name: Intro Split — Oblique

Compact team. World-class brands.

We believe in what a small, agile team can do. Every project gets our best people, because that is the whole team we have.

As brand builders at heart, we stay small enough to plug directly into in-house teams. That approach makes for tailored, strategic, close collaboration — and partnerships that produce work worth pointing at.

name: Services — Oblique
html:
(Services)

From core brand foundations to dynamic brand extensions.

Learn more about our approach

  • 1

    (Identities)

    Creating motion identities that are compelling and distinct.

    We craft motion identities that embody the core and character of brands. Each identity is built with intention — distinct, differentiated, compelling, and scalable into broader systems.

  • 2

    (Systems)

    Building flexible systems that scale across every touchpoint.

    We design the underlying rules that let a moving identity stretch from a splash screen to a stadium feed without ever losing its shape.

  • 3

    (Guidelines)

    Documenting guidelines a growing team can actually use.

    Guidelines are only useful if people open them. Ours are built for the in-house teams and vendors who inherit the identity after we hand it off.

  • 4

    (Toolkits)

    Shipping toolkits that keep motion consistent at scale.

    Editable templates, source files, and presets so an internal team can keep producing on-brand motion long after our engagement ends.

name: About — Oblique
html:
Small and closely integrated, a true extension of your team.

(Company)

Global client base, remote-first operations — based in Vancouver, Canada.

OBLIQUE is a studio at the forefront of building identities, systems, guidelines, and toolkits for motion. As a small team, we offer a more direct partnership, sized to integrate and problem-solve alongside you as a true extension of your brand team.

At our core, we are brand builders. We immerse ourselves in a client's world to understand what makes their brand distinct, where the opportunities sit, and how they define success.

Every engagement is tailored to fit, and every project gets our best people — because that is all we have. That approach has earned the trust of some of the most ambitious brands we've worked with, who treat us as true partners in bringing their ideas to life.
